about: Filter 1 of a voice of the Audio Unit (osc A alone goes through it, on a sine of ours at the amplitude A Level²), Freq the note 136.8 v, Drive and Var 0. peaks: [type, res, note, cents, gain] a sine of 1e-4 (the small signal) at the note, the cutoff `cents` under it: the gain of the sine against the filter off (dB). levels: [type, res, note, amplitude, gain, harmonics] a sine at the cutoff: the gain of its fundamental (dB), its harmonics 2..7 under it (dB). fine: [type, res, note, cents, gain] as peaks, MG Low 24 on fine grids around its peak at Res 0.8..1. scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=filter-resonance [--parts=peaks,levels,fine]
